Refund responses must contain "approved".

limitations: Unkeyed checksums detect modification relative to trusted digests; they do not authenticate an attacker-writable envelope. Recomputed reviewer metadata checksum acceptance is an authenticity limitation, not a failed source-content integrity assertion.
